artifacts.label: confirmatory result
artifacts.description: In the simulation (static preferences, matched pools, eta 0, alpha_0 1.0, true like rate calibrated to 0.577), content-similarity ranking lowered final-window exposure topic entropy H_exp relative to random ranking by 0.4000 (95% paired t-interval [-0.4028, -0.3972], 20 seeds); H1 supported under the frozen rule.
artifacts.metric_definition: H_exp(u) = -sum_z q_uz ln q_uz / ln K over the last W = 50 slates, position weights 0.85^(j-1); run value = mean over users (protocol section 4)

artifacts.label: confirmatory result (secondary cells)
artifacts.description: The EXP-001 similarity-minus-random reduction in H_exp was between -0.3938 and -0.4000 in all four (eta, alpha_0) cells, each with H1 supported under the frozen rule.
artifacts.metric_definition: H_exp(u) = -sum_z q_uz ln q_uz / ln K over the last W = 50 slates, position weights 0.85^(j-1); run value = mean over users (protocol section 4)
artifacts.figure_or_table: EXP-001-FIG-C01; EXP-001 tables.md Table C; manuscript Table 2

artifacts.label: confirmatory secondary result
artifacts.description: In EXP-001 (primary cell) MMR re-ranking recovered part of the entropy loss of similarity ranking (MMR minus similarity +0.2147, 95% t [0.2125, 0.2169]); the bandit lowered H_exp by 0.2920 and MMR by 0.1853 relative to random; popularity changed H_exp by only -0.0089 [-0.0115, -0.0064], below the smallest effect of interest, while raising item-exposure Gini by 0.7308.
artifacts.metric_definition: H_exp(u) = -sum_z q_uz ln q_uz / ln K over the last W = 50 slates, position weights 0.85^(j-1); run value = mean over users (protocol section 4)
artifacts.figure_or_table: EXP-001 tables.md Table B; manuscript Table 3

artifacts.label: confirmatory result
artifacts.description: Under the drifting-preference model (gamma 0.05, alpha_0 1.0), similarity ranking changed normalised preference entropy by -0.4350 relative to random (95% t [-0.4387, -0.4313], 20 seeds); H1 supported. Under random ranking preference entropy rose (+0.0971), under similarity it fell (-0.3379); MMR recovered about 37% of the contrast (MMR minus similarity +0.1626).
artifacts.metric_definition: (H(p_u(T)) - H(p_u(0))) / ln K, mean over users (EXP-002 protocol section 5)
artifacts.figure_or_table: EXP-002-FIG-C01; EXP-002 tables.md Tables A to C; manuscript Table 4

artifacts.label: confirmatory sensitivity result
artifacts.description: The EXP-002 drift-form rule was not met: D under additive-then-clip was -0.4363 (alpha_0 1.0) and -0.4351 (alpha_0 0.1), same sign and above 0.05 in size. The check is weak: for non-negative p, additive-then-clip followed by normalisation equals the multiplicative rule with gamma/(1+gamma) unless the clip binds.
artifacts.run_ids: EXP-002-driftform-* (80 runs) and EXP-002-main-gamma=0.05-* similarity and random
artifacts.metric_definition: Gini, relevance, miscalibration KL, user control, like rate (protocol section 5)
artifacts.figure_or_table: EXP-002-FIG-C01; EXP-002 tables.md Table D; manuscript Table 4

artifacts.label: confirmatory sensitivity result
artifacts.description: With a Zipf-skewed catalog the similarity-minus-random H_exp contrast was -0.5060 (tau 0.1, 95% t [-0.5169, -0.4951]) and -0.5365 (tau 0.3, [-0.5469, -0.5260]); neither the skew nor the sharpness invalidation criterion of EXP-003 was met, and no sign reversal occurred at the frozen calibration.
artifacts.metric_definition: H_exp(u) = -sum_z q_uz ln q_uz / ln K over the last W = 50 slates, position weights 0.85^(j-1); run value = mean over users (protocol section 4)
artifacts.figure_or_table: EXP-003-FIG-C01; EXP-003 tables.md Table C; manuscript Table 5

artifacts.label: confirmatory result (interaction)
artifacts.description: The similarity-minus-random H_exp reduction was larger under the Zipf catalog than under the uniform catalog: interaction -0.1059 (tau 0.1, Welch 95% [-0.1170, -0.0948]) and -0.1503 (tau 0.3, [-0.1611, -0.1396]).
artifacts.metric_definition: H_exp(u) = -sum_z q_uz ln q_uz / ln K over the last W = 50 slates, position weights 0.85^(j-1); run value = mean over users (protocol section 4)
artifacts.figure_or_table: EXP-003-FIG-C01; EXP-003 tables.md Table D; manuscript Table 5

artifacts.label: confirmatory result (second test)
artifacts.description: With MovieLens 1M held-out-half preference vectors and catalog topic weights, similarity ranking lowered H_exp relative to random by 0.4095 (95% t [-0.4210, -0.3980], 20 seeds); H1 supported, contradiction rule not met, no sign reversal.
artifacts.metric_definition: H_exp(u) = -sum_z q_uz ln q_uz / ln K over the last W = 50 slates, position weights 0.85^(j-1); run value = mean over users (protocol section 4)
artifacts.figure_or_table: EXP-004-FIG-C01; EXP-004 tables.md Table C; manuscript Table 6

artifacts.label: confirmatory secondary result
artifacts.description: In EXP-001 (primary cell) similarity ranking gave the highest relevance and like rate of all arms (similarity minus random: relevance +0.0603, like rate +0.1283), while MMR lowered miscalibration relative to random (-0.1874 nats) at a small relevance cost relative to similarity (-0.0100).
artifacts.metric_definition: Gini, relevance, miscalibration KL, user control, like rate (protocol section 5)
artifacts.figure_or_table: EXP-001 tables.md Table B; manuscript Table 3

artifacts.label: confirmatory secondary result
artifacts.description: In EXP-004 MMR stayed close to random in topic entropy (MMR minus random -0.0864, 95% t [-0.0911, -0.0817]) while losing little relevance relative to similarity (-0.0013 [-0.0019, -0.0007]).
artifacts.metric_definition: Gini, relevance, miscalibration KL, user control, like rate (protocol section 5)
artifacts.figure_or_table: EXP-004 tables.md Table B; manuscript Table 6

artifacts.label: confirmatory secondary result
artifacts.description: Under the Zipf catalog MMR recovered more of the similarity loss than under the uniform catalog (MMR minus similarity +0.3669 and +0.4256 under Zipf against +0.2150 and +0.2306 under uniform, tau 0.1 and 0.3).
artifacts.metric_definition: Gini, relevance, miscalibration KL, user control, like rate (protocol section 5)
artifacts.figure_or_table: EXP-003 tables.md Table B; manuscript Table 5

artifacts.label: exploratory result
artifacts.description: EXPLORATORY (M4, 5 seeds, not a confirmatory result): with the settings of the EXP-003 tau 0.1 block and the midpoint refitted for target true like rates from 0.02 to 0.85, the similarity-minus-random H_exp contrast under the uniform catalog was near zero at like rates 0.02 and 0.05 (-0.0032 and -0.0057), -0.0384 at 0.15, -0.2396 at 0.30 and between -0.3910 and -0.3961 from 0.45 upward; under the Zipf catalog it was positive at 0.02 to 0.15 (+0.1045, +0.1026, +0.0724) and negative from 0.30 upward (-0.1258 to -0.7106).
